T_k: The correction keeps a mean-centred saturating even term in x4, with slightly reduced amplitude, so that large |x4| raises the prediction and x4 near zero lowers it. It also adds a saturating x2*x5 interaction that pulls predictions down when x2 and x5 have opposite signs (the shared feature of the worst over-predictions) and up when they agree. The result is clipped for stability.
